name: Ustad Rafiq Ahmed
title: Master Tailor — Bridal Lehenga & Gharara
tagline: The heavier the dupatta, the more careful the seam has to be.
bio: Specializes in heavily embellished bridal wear — lehengas, ghararas, and sharara sets built to carry kilos of zari and stonework without pulling at the seams.

name: Baji Nasreen Kausar
title: Master Tailor — Zardozi & Tilla Finishing
tagline: Hand embroidery is a conversation between the needle and the fabric — you can't rush it.
bio: One of the few remaining specialists in traditional zardozi (gold-thread) and tilla work in Lahore, finishing garments for bridal houses across the city before starting her own studio.
specialties: [{"title": "Zardozi embroidery", "description": "Traditional gold and silver thread hand embroidery on heavy fabrics."}, {"title": "Tilla work", "description": "Metallic thread couching, common on bridal and festive wear."}, {"title": "Gota patti finishing", "description": "Ribbon-based embellishment for lighter festive garments."}]

name: Ustad Iqbal Hussain
title: Master Tailor — Kurta Shalwar & Everyday Menswear
tagline: A good kurta shalwar should feel like nothing — that's the whole point.
bio: Runs a high-volume everyday-wear practice — kurta shalwar, casual kameez, and office-appropriate menswear — with a focus on consistent, repeatable fit across dozens of orders a month.

title: Master Tailor — Kidswear & School Uniforms

name: Ustad Farhan Malik
title: Master Tailor — Chikankari Specialist
tagline: White thread on white cloth hides nothing. Every stitch has to be perfect.
bio: Focuses on chikankari — fine, traditionally white-thread shadow embroidery — on both bridal and everyday lawn and cotton garments, working with embroiderers trained in the Lucknawi tradition.

name: Baji Robina Yousaf
title: Master Tailor — Anarkali, Frocks & Angrakha
tagline: Flow is the hardest thing to sew — it has to move like it isn't stitched at all.
bio: Known for flared, flowing silhouettes — Anarkali suits, layered frocks, and traditional Angrakha-style wrap kurtas — that need precise panel-cutting to drape correctly rather than just hang.
specialties: [{"title": "Anarkali suits", "description": "Multi-panel flared construction, floor and calf-length."}, {"title": "Layered frocks", "description": "Gathered-layer party and formal frocks for women and girls."}, {"title": "Angrakha style", "description": "Traditional asymmetric wrap-front kurta construction."}]
timeline: [{"year": "2007", "title": "Opened studio focused on flared silhouettes", "description": "Built a reputation for panel-cutting precision."}]
testimonials: [{"quote": "It moves exactly the way it did on the hanger. That almost never happens with Anarkalis.", "name": "Mehwish Tariq", "location": "Lahore"}]

title: Master Tailor — Western Formalwear & Alterations
